description: Bridge for the Node-RED /ui and Vue /shack 'Outlets' tabs (vu2cpl-shack repo, 2026-11-17). Publishes the 9 shack outlets as retained JSON on shack/smarteefi/state (on change, every minute, at start) and switches them on commands from shack/smarteefi/set {"entity_id":..., "action":"on|off|toggle"}. Only the outlets listed in the variables can be switched. Keep the trigger entity list and the variables list the same.

variables.eid: {{ (trigger.payload_json.entity_id if trigger.payload_json is defined and trigger.payload_json is mapping else '') | string }}
variables.act: {{ (trigger.payload_json.action if trigger.payload_json is defined and trigger.payload_json is mapping else '') | string | lower }}

then.value_template: {{ eid in (outlets | map(attribute='id') | list) and act in ['on', 'off', 'toggle'] }}

data.payload: {%- set ns = namespace(l=[]) -%}{%- for o in outlets -%}{%- set ns.l = ns.l + [{'id': o.id, 'name': o.name, 'group': o.group, 'state': states(o.id)}] -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ {'ts': now().timestamp() | int, 'outlets': ns.l} | to_json }}
